claim: Every newly selected critical-path hygiene packet has one unique obligation-quality record with RIPR, an oracle grade meeting its path rule, and an executed mutation tied to a selected pinned test.
promotion_scope: The repository may report structural Test Quality V2 compliance and execute the exact V1-pinned pytest nodes for this assurance change.

failure_model.description: A critical change passes V1 technique and hash checks while supplying no falsifiable V2 semantic obligation.
failure_model.coordinate_changed: Remove the unique V2 packet linked to the V1 packet selected for a critical path.

failure_model.description: A test executes the changed path but reveals only process success or same-implementation self-consistency.
failure_model.coordinate_changed: Lower the declared oracle independence grade below the minimum for the matched path rule.

failure_model.description: An agent names a hypothetical mutant without linking it to an exact selected and executable pinned test node.
failure_model.coordinate_changed: Replace the required killed mutation with a prose counterexample or an unpinned killer node.

ripr.reach: The V1 diff classifier selects each changed critical path and records the exact V1 evidence packet chosen for that path.
ripr.infect: Removing or weakening the linked V2 record leaves a selected V1 packet without the required obligation, oracle grade, or executed falsifier.
ripr.propagate: The V1 path-to-evidence mapping reaches the V2 linkage and per-rule requirement comparison before any declared tests execute.
ripr.reveal: A closed decision table rejects the missing link, low oracle grade, missing mutation kind, or killer node outside the selected V1 packet.

representation_review.action: Reuse the V1 path registry and selected test nodes, then enforce one unique V2 packet per selected V1 packet through closed parsers.

rejected_alternatives.reason: A passing packet example would not demonstrate that missing links, weak grades, and unpinned killers fail closed.
The initial contract has a small closed decision space where exact one-coordinate mutants provide clearer fault localization.

oracle.description: The reviewed V2 decision table requires one exact link, oracle grade at least two, required mutation kind, and killer nodes contained in the selected V1 packet.
oracle.independent_source: The machine contract, fixed fixture packets, and explicit expected-error decision table are separate from candidate agent reports.
oracle.exact_error_or_precedence: V1 structural selection succeeds first; V2 then rejects missing linkage, schema defects, rule shortfall, or killer mismatch before pytest execution.

reject_is_noop.reason: Both checkers are read-only and negative fixture tests verify rejection without modifying retained repository evidence.

falsifiers.semantic_change: Delete the V2 packet after a critical path has selected a valid and current V1 packet.
falsifiers.result: The checker raises the stable selected-hygiene-evidence-lacks-V2-quality-obligation rejection.
falsifiers.smallest_witness: One changed critical source, one valid V1 packet, one pinned pytest node, and zero V2 packets.

falsifiers.semantic_change: Change the obligation oracle grade from the required boundary value two to the lower neighbor one.
falsifiers.result: The checker rejects the packet because its oracle independence grade is below the matched path minimum.
falsifiers.smallest_witness: One valid linked obligation with a single integer grade changed from two to one.

falsifiers.semantic_change: Replace the exact selected pinned killer node with an unpinned node in the same test file.
falsifiers.result: The checker rejects the falsifier because its killer is outside the selected V1 node inventory.
falsifiers.smallest_witness: One falsifier record with one test-node identifier changed.

minimal_test_inventory.rationale: The V2 tests isolate schema, selection, rule, mutation-linkage, append-only, workflow, and runner faults while retaining V1 hash and argv protections.

counterexample.rationale: The missing-link regression is the minimized counterexample for technique-presence evidence without an obligation-quality record.
counterexample.minimized_size: One critical path, one V1 packet, and no linked V2 packet.

metrics.runtime_delta: The focused 35-test V1 and V2 set completed in 0.28 seconds locally.

nonclaims: The structural checker cannot prove that natural-language RIPR or oracle descriptions are truthful.
The initial V2 runner executes V1-pinned pytest nodes and does not yet provide native Rust test selectors or a repository-wide mutation kill matrix.
No ZenoDEX production, proof-soundness, whole-economy, branch-protection, or release-readiness claim is promoted by this packet.
